entries.title: A Look into the Night Sky with Astro Everywhere
entries.description: We’ll gather in the Treetop Room for a live astronomy show featuring planetarium software to explore the night sky as seen from Palo Alto.
entries.priorTitleZh: 与 Astro Everywhere 一起探索夜空
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 大家将在 Treetop Room 观看现场天文演示，使用天文馆软件探索从 Palo Alto 看到的夜空。

entries.title: Miniature Snowmen with Local Color
entries.description: Learn the art of the miniature in this free winter workshop (for ages 8+).

entries.title: CHCP Celebrates Heritage Holiday
entries.description: The Chinese American Historical Museum (CAHM) is housed in the Ng Shing Gung building, which is part of History Park, located in Kelley Park, San Jose.

entries.title: Pan Dulce Lotería
entries.description: Strengthen your community and join us for a lively game afternoon.
entries.priorTitleZh: Pan Dulce Lotería 甜面包主题游戏
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 放松心情，一起玩几轮精彩的 Lotería 游戏。带上幸运物，准备喊出“Lotería！”必须报名。

entries.title: Neurosphere: Neuroscience and More! Grades 3-8
entries.description: This session will dive into the basics of brain function, fun activities to test your brainpower, and an introduction to future career opportunities.

entries.title: Winter Terrarium with Pixie Pop-Ups
entries.description: Get creative and build your own unique terrarium in this free all ages workshop with Pixie Pop-Ups.

entries.title: Inclusive Sensory Movement & Regulation Workshop~  REGULACION SENSORIAL CON MUSICA
entries.description: Led by trained JMM Dance Co. facilitators, children are invited to participate at their own comfort level—moving, observing, or resting as needed.

entries.title: Sunday CrafterNoon
entries.description: This craft is self-directed; children must come with their responsible adult crafting-buddy.

entries.title: Creating Wooden Toys with SCRAP SF
entries.description: Step into the world of mechanical art in this free workshop with SCRAP SF (for ages 8+).

entries.title: U-2 & T-38 Pilot
entries.description: After retiring from active duty in 2014, John "Huggy" Huggins made history when he became the first civilian instructor pilot to fly the iconic U-2 solo.

entries.title: Noon Year’s Eve
entries.description: Kids and parents, come celebrate the New Year with music, activities, face painting and a countdown to THREE GIANT balloon drops at noon!

entries.title: Scout Day
entries.description: Explore historic airplanes and helicopters and learn more about the special programs offered at the Hiller Aviation Museum for BSA Scouts and Girl Scouts throughout the year.

entries.title: Aero Design Challenge (ADC)
entries.description: Aero Design Challenge is an exploration into design and engineering.
